verdict.rationale: Relay's docs directly describe building a cash cushion with high-yield savings accounts and automated rules (relay-docs-6). They say auto-transfer rules move excess cash from operating accounts into savings earning up to 3.00% APY (relay-docs-24, relay-docs-30), with transfers configurable by dollar amounts or percentages (relay-docs-15). A community user independently notes automatic partitioning and extra interest on allocated funds (relay-comm-1). Missing for 10: detailed support documentation on configuring the savings auto-transfer rules (triggers, thresholds), and hands-on corroboration that the savings-specific rules work as described.
